formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages and eased 1300m.Raced wide without cover from the 1000m. When questioned regarding his tactics from the 1000m rider explained the gelding had been over-racing up until this point and with the slow tempo of the event he elected to improve his position as the gelding is one paced and he was of the view he would be unable to improve once the pace quickened. He added the gelding started to give ground from the 400m and maybe better suited in contesting races of a further distance.

formRaceEntries.comment: Jumped well caught Wide pressed forward to settle outside the leader 1 length , under pressure from the 800 , gave ground to straightening up hard ridden 5 lengths dropped right out , visors off # beaten before turn
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Raced wide in the early stages before being allowed to stride forward and settle outside the leader near the 1400m. Rider reported he had been instructed to attempt to ride in the first half of the field with cover. he added that when it was evident he would not be able to obtain cover in the early stages, he elected to roll forward and settle outside the lead. added that the gelding then failed to respond to his riding from the 800m and was disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to have minor lacerations to both hind fetlocks. Stewards will follow up
